senses.gloss:
ITA-8.2.21 kilāṭam किलाटम्
Inspissated milk
The solid part of milk obtained through curdling.

ITA-5.70.4 kīlakaḥ कीलकः
Obstructed fetal presentation with both hands, feet and head wedged upwards
Abnormal fetal presentation characterized by fetus seen presenting at vagina with both hands; feet and head wedged upwards; a category of compound fetal presentation. Ayurvedic literature describes this as obstructed fetal presentation resembling a wedge blocking the vagina.
